evals.prompt: Init this project for AI-assisted development.
evals.expected_output: Runs read-only detection, proposes a guide-generation plan, waits for explicit approval before writing, generates .agentic/guides content, wires the AI entrypoint, and validates the result.

assertions.name: detects-before-writing
assertions.description: The response performs read-only detection and planning before any writes.

assertions.name: hard-approval-gate
assertions.description: The response requires explicit approval before generating guide files.

evals.prompt: Run knowledge foundation in a repo that already has .agentic/guides and AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: Detects existing guides and entrypoint wiring, proposes updates rather than duplicating parallel guide trees, and preserves .agentic/guides as the source of truth.

assertions.name: handles-existing-guides
assertions.description: The response accounts for existing .agentic/guides.

assertions.name: single-source-of-truth
assertions.description: The response does not create a competing guide tree outside .agentic/guides.

evals.prompt: Initialize knowledge foundation in an empty repo with no manifests and no source files.
evals.expected_output: Halts after detection because project shape confidence is insufficient or the repo is empty, and asks for required project context instead of generating generic guides.

assertions.name: halts-empty-repo
assertions.description: The response does not generate generic guides for an empty repository.

assertions.name: asks-for-context
assertions.description: The response explains what context is needed to continue.

evals.prompt: Run knowledge foundation for a monorepo where the host exposes superpowers:brainstorming and superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents.
evals.expected_output: Uses superpowers:brainstorming to drive the Phase 2 planning conversation, waits for explicit approval before writing, uses superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents for parallel monorepo guide generation, and Never auto-install superpowers or any other tooling.

assertions.name: uses-brainstorming-when-available
assertions.description: The response invokes superpowers:brainstorming when the host exposes it instead of presenting only the inline fallback plan.

assertions.name: uses-parallel-dispatch-when-available
assertions.description: The response invokes superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents for monorepo guide generation when available.

assertions.name: does-not-install-superpowers
assertions.description: The response states or follows the rule: Never auto-install superpowers; fall back when they are unavailable.

evals.prompt: Run knowledge foundation in a repo that already contains AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude, .codex, and .agentic/guides.
evals.expected_output: Calls or consumes knowledge-auditor before writing, summarizes the existing AI guidance surfaces, proposes a merge or update plan, and waits for approval before modifying files.

assertions.name: uses-knowledge-auditor
assertions.description: The response calls or consumes knowledge-auditor before generating or editing guides.

assertions.name: audits-existing-ai-guidance
assertions.description: The response accounts for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude, .codex, and .agentic/guides before writing.

assertions.name: approval-before-write
assertions.description: The response does not write until the user approves the proposed guide update plan.

evals.prompt: Run knowledge foundation in a repo that has both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md with existing assistant instructions plus .codex and .claude directories.
evals.expected_output: Consumes the knowledge audit, identifies all assistant surfaces, treats AGENTS.md as the primary generated entrypoint when approved, renders CLAUDE.md as a minimal @AGENTS.md shim, and gates each target diff independently before writing.

assertions.name: audits-multiple-entrypoints
assertions.description: The response accounts for both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md plus tool-specific directories before planning writes.

assertions.name: resolves-authority-before-write
assertions.description: The response asks the user or presents per-target recommendations when multiple assistant entrypoints may be authoritative.

assertions.name: preserves-human-content
assertions.description: The response keeps content outside managed regions unchanged unless explicitly approved, except for an approved CLAUDE.md shim replacement.

assertions.name: claude-shim
assertions.description: When AGENTS.md is primary, CLAUDE.md contains an @AGENTS.md import and does not duplicate generated guide tables, commands, or task classifiers.

evals.prompt: Run knowledge foundation in a repo whose AGENTS.md contains stale agentic-init managed blocks that point to deleted guide paths.
evals.expected_output: Uses the audit recommendation to mark stale managed regions for replace or merge, shows a per-file diff, requires approval before updating managed blocks, and does not touch unrelated AGENTS.md content.

assertions.name: detects-stale-managed-blocks
assertions.description: The response recognizes stale managed-region content and unresolved guide paths from the audit.

assertions.name: managed-region-only-update
assertions.description: The response confines default entrypoint changes to managed regions.

assertions.name: diff-gated-replacement
assertions.description: The response shows a diff and waits for explicit approval before replacing stale managed blocks.

evals.prompt: Run knowledge foundation in a repo where AGENTS.md says to run npm test, CLAUDE.md says tests are forbidden, and CI runs make test.
evals.expected_output: Treats the assistant commands as conflicting audit evidence, halts or asks the user to choose the authoritative test command before generating quality gates or entrypoint commands, and avoids encoding a confident command.

assertions.name: detects-conflicting-commands
assertions.description: The response identifies incompatible assistant and CI command guidance before planning writes.

assertions.name: asks-or-halts-on-conflict
assertions.description: The response asks the user or halts instead of resolving the conflict silently.

assertions.name: does-not-invent-command
assertions.description: The response does not generate quality gate or entrypoint commands from conflicting evidence without confirmation.

evals.prompt: Run knowledge foundation in a repo with a generic README, no docs directory, no tests, and only weak evidence for architecture and workflow guides.
evals.expected_output: Rates the weak documentation through the audit, asks for authoritative context or skips unsupported guide categories, and does not generate confident project-specific guidance without concrete file evidence and approval.

assertions.name: rates-weak-docs
assertions.description: The response treats generic or sparse docs as weak audit evidence.

assertions.name: skips-or-asks-on-weak-evidence
assertions.description: The response asks for context or skips categories with weak or missing evidence.

assertions.name: requires-file-line-evidence
assertions.description: The response does not plan confident guide generation without concrete repository evidence.

evals.prompt: Run knowledge foundation in a repo with enough evidence for concise guides but not enough content to fill 200 lines per file.
evals.expected_output: Generates concise guides without padding, does not target a minimum line count, and fails validation if any generated guide contains Review reminder, Foundation reminder, Operating reminder, repeated near-identical filler lines, or placeholder rows.

assertions.name: no-line-count-minimum
assertions.description: The response treats guide and entrypoint line counts as hard maximums only, never as minimums.

assertions.name: rejects-reminder-padding
assertions.description: The response rejects generated guides containing reminder/filler padding such as Review reminder, Foundation reminder, or Operating reminder lines.

assertions.name: rejects-repeated-filler
assertions.description: The response detects and rejects repeated near-identical lines that exist only to satisfy a line-count target.

evals.prompt: Run knowledge foundation for a project that uses Jira, GitLab merge requests, branch and commit conventions, and Makefile quality gates.
evals.expected_output: Writes project.md using the strict Project Context schema with project identity, work item tracker, ticket adapter, source control/review context, and a dedicated MR Adapter section; routes branch/commit/merge conventions to git-workflow.md, exact commands to quality-gates.md, and task routing to the entrypoint.

assertions.name: project-context-schema
assertions.description: The generated project.md contains only Project Identity, Work Item Tracker, Ticket Adapter, Source Control And Review, and MR Adapter sections.

assertions.name: drift-redistributed
assertions.description: Git conventions, exact quality commands, task routing, and package ownership are not added to project.md and are written to their owning guides instead.

assertions.name: adapter-config-extractable
assertions.description: The project.md schema exposes ticket adapter configuration and the dedicated MR Adapter section for product-owner, requirements-intake, mr-creator, and babysit-mr.

evals.prompt: Run knowledge foundation in a repo where AGENTS.md is the selected target and the repo also has CLAUDE.md plus an existing .agentic/runs/main.json file.
evals.expected_output: Generates AGENTS.md as the canonical managed entrypoint, rewrites CLAUDE.md only as a minimal @AGENTS.md shim after showing the CLAUDE.md diff and getting approval, adds .agentic/runs/ to .gitignore, and ensures the run journal is ignored or removed if untracked.

assertions.name: agents-primary
assertions.description: The generated guide imports, task classifier, critical rules, and command references live in AGENTS.md.

assertions.name: claude-shim-only
assertions.description: CLAUDE.md is reduced to a short purpose line and managed @AGENTS.md import, without duplicated generated guidance.

assertions.name: runs-ignored
assertions.description: The workflow adds .agentic/runs/ to .gitignore and does not leave an untracked .agentic/runs/<branch>.json to commit.
